translations.web: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
translations.bsb: Moreover, because the dream was given to Pharaoh in two versions, the matter has been decreed by God, and He will carry it out shortly.
translations.kjv: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
translations.asv: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh, it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
